subject: Hosted API commit pricing — SOC2/DPA gating for volume discounts
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — commit tiers

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile. Procurement asked me to confirm how commit-based discounts work for the hosted API. High-level: we expect ~18B tokens/month after launch and would commit 12 months up front if we can get a meaningful per-token reduction.

Two gating items from legal/security that will determine whether we can sign a commit:
- Signed DPA in place with standard data residency and processing clauses;
- SOC 2 Type II evidence (redacted copy is fine) covering the hosted environment that will serve our prod traffic.

Can you confirm: do you require both signed DPA and SOC2 evidence before the volume discount takes effect? Also please share a pricing example for a 12-month, 18B token/month commit (per-token) vs on-demand usage.

If you can send a draft DPA and the SOC2 report or a pathway to get it, procurement will start the review.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Jones
Sr. Sourcing Manager — Acme Health
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — commit tiers

Samantha — appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, for allowed enterprise commit discounts we require an executed DPA; SOC2 Type II evidence can be provided as a redacted report, and we typically share it under an NDA or via a secure share link. Once both are in place we can apply the commit pricing retroactively to the start date you agree in the contract (not retroactive to usage before signature).

Pricing example (ballpark) for a 12-mo commit, 18B tokens/month:
- On-demand list rate: $0.0006 / token (standard host pricing)
- 12-mo commit (volume commit): $0.00040 / token (approximately 33% reduction)
- Additional volume tiers available at >30B/month — can go lower with a stepped schedule.

Notes/constraints:
- Minimum annual commitment: $X (we'll provide exact $numbers in a formal quote).
- Discount eligibility requires: signed DPA + SOC2 redacted evidence (we can start DPA review immediately).
- If SOC2 evidence is delayed but DPA is signed, we can provisionally hold the pricing for 30 days while you complete the security review, subject to exec approval.

I've attached a Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx and a draft DPA (DPA_draft_acme_20260310.pdf). Neha is looped to help with legal language. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk procurement/security through the SOC2 artifacts.

Next step: Marissa, can you prepare a formal quote and the mutual action plan if Acme confirms the target commit?

Thanks,
Diego
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — commit tiers

Hi Samantha — following up with a draft mutual action plan attached (Mutual_Action_Plan-Acme.docx) and the formal quote (see Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx in the thread). Key commercials in the quote:
- 12-month commitment: 18B tokens/month at $0.000395 / token (final price contingent on DPA & SOC2 confirmation).
- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears against committed usage; true-up on overage at the committed rate, under-usage credit applies per contract.
- Early termination: pro-rated buyout if early termination within first 6 months.

If procurement/finance needs an alternate billing cadence or invoicing entity, flag that now and we can adjust. Vivek — FYI on the provisional hold policy Diego mentioned.

Samantha — if you can confirm the stakeholder list (procurement + InfoSec + legal), I'll schedule a 30-min runbook review next week.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — SOC2 scope question

Thanks — quick security question before we start review: does the SOC2 cover the hosted multi-tenant environment or only the control plane? We need assurance that the inference runtime and telemetry collection are in scope (we'll redact any customer-specific logs). Also can you confirm retention windows for logs and whether you support customer-managed KMS keys for models/prefix data?

If you can provide a redacted SOC2 with a short cover letter indicating scope (runtime + control plane) and retention policy, that will speed up our legal/security signoff.

Best,
Michael
Director, Information Security — Acme Health
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — SOC2 scope question

Michael — thanks for the specifics. We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report that explicitly lists the collection/retention controls for the inference runtime and the control plane. High-level answers:
- Scope: SOC2 report covers our hosted control plane and the inference runtime used for hosted API customers.
- Logs & retention: default retention for control-plane telemetry is 90 days; requestable retention extensions available on dedicated/private deployments.
- KMS: supported for Private deployments and Dedicated; for hosted API we offer envelope encryption and can discuss Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) options for certain enterprise contracts.

I'll send the redacted SOC2 via secure share. Regarding the DPA: the attached DPA_draft_acme_20260310.pdf is our standard template; we're open to a few minor redlines around breach notification windows. We typically require an executed DPA before the effective date of any commit discount; see clause 3.2 in the DPA draft.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security — Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@acmehealth.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — final steps to lock commit pricing

Samantha — quick summary and proposed next steps to keep timelines tight:
1) Redwood will prepare a formal DocuSign with the 12-mo 18B token/month quote at $0.000395/token. Price is contingent on execution of the DPA and receipt of redacted SOC2 evidence.
2) We will provisionally reserve the quoted price for 21 days from DOcuSign send date to allow Acme to complete internal review; if SOC2 is delayed beyond that window we will place the price on hold pending security acceptance.
3) Neha will send the redacted SOC2 via secure share link and the DPA DocuSign.
4) Procurement: if you confirm the billing entity and PO process, we will include that in the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments included in thread: DPA_draft_acme_20260310.pdf (for review), SOC2_report_redacted_2025.pdf (redacted copy), Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan-Acme.docx.

Would you like to set a single 30-min session next week to walk the security team through the SOC2 artifacts and the retention/KMS controls? I'm available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
Diego
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
